    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to AUTO

    markdown: "The type of connector for the preset. Valid values are: email, eventbridge, generic_https, incident_io, microsoft_teams, pagerduty, pagerduty_incidents, service_now, slack, unspecified. `incident_io` is a preview type."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["email" "eventbridge" "generic_https" "incident_io" "microsoft_teams" "pagerduty" "pagerduty_incidents" "service_now" "slack" "unspecified"]
